name: Introducing Platform Elements
summary: Vercel changelog post introducing Platform Elements: prebuilt shadcn/ui blocks and actions for platform features.
description: A Vercel changelog entry (5 Dec 2025) announcing Platform Elements, part of the Vercel for Platforms product: a library of production-ready shadcn/ui components and actions you drop into your app. It lists the blocks (custom-domain, deploy-popover, dns-table, claim-deployment, report-abuse) and actions (add-custom-domain, deploy-files), the Vercel Platforms CLI install and quickstarts for multi-tenant and multi-project platforms.
contains: Introduces Platform Elements from the Vercel for Platforms product
Blocks: custom-domain, deploy-popover, dns-table, claim-deployment, report-abuse
Install with the Vercel Platforms CLI
Quickstarts for multi-tenant and multi-project platforms
